segments.text: THIS Article is placed in the end: 1. Becauſe it is perfectlie fulfilled after the reſt. 2. Becauſe it is an effect of all the other articles; that is, we beleeue all the other articles for this, and all things that we beleeue were done, that we might beleeue this article, and ſo at length inioy euerlaſting life. This article is the end and roofe of our whole ſaluation and life.
The chiefe queſtions of euerlaſting life.

1 What euerlaſting life is.
2 Of whom it is giuen.
3 To whom it is giuen.
4 Wherefore it is giuen.
5 When it is giuen.
6 How it is giuen.
7 Whether in this life wee may bee aſſured of euerlasting life.
